facts.summary: Voluntary enrollment pause after manufacturing failures · Phase 2 · ITIL-168 in advanced melanoma · not yet approved

evidence.summary: voluntarily paused enrollment in DELTA-1, the Company’s Phase 2 clinical trial of ITIL-168 in patients with advanced melanoma.
evidence.safety: A pre-specified safety analysis in the DELTA-1 trial has been conducted on patients who received ITIL-168 and did not identify any unexpected safety issues.
evidence.program_discontinued: upon completion of this analysis, plans to take corrective actions to improve the rate of manufacturing success and resume the study.
